name: York KAMPground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 40.8242,-97.5928: gravel pull-through rows on open ground south of the office between motels and a field; a marshy pond lies ~200 m east behind a brush strip; default down - not waterfront

name: Little Rivers Edge RV Park
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.6537,-96.2095: the gravel site loop sits on an open rise south of the Little Nemaha, whose bends pass ~60-120 m north and east of the pads behind grass slope and a tree line; the operator's 'overlooks the river' is marketing and the sightline can't be confirmed through the trees; default down - not waterfront

name: Beaver Crossing Park Campground
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.7764,-97.2775: the camping area is gravel by the Elk St entrance between the playground and the ball fields in the village park; only a narrow drainage channel runs past; not waterfront

name: Auburn RV Park (City of Auburn)
evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 40.4015,-95.8482: the RV loop is a gravel pad ring north of the rec-complex parking lot; a wooded creek passes ~80 m north/east behind a full tree band; not waterfront
